📖 How to use

❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What if a = 0?
Then there is no x term: if b equals c every x works, otherwise no x works.
Why show a check?
Plugging x back into the original equation proves the answer — the two sides must match.
Can it solve 2x = 8?
Yes — that is just a=2, b=0, c=8, giving x = 4.
